cross-os-testing.name: Cross-OS Testing
cross-os-testing.description: Test across multiple operating systems (Ubuntu, Windows, macOS)

template.yaml:
strategy:
  matrix:
    os:
      - ubuntu-latest
      - windows-latest
      - macos-latest

strategy:
  matrix:
    node-version:
      - 18
      - 20
      - 22

paths-ignore.name: Paths Ignore
paths-ignore.description: Skip CI runs for documentation-only changes

template.yaml:
on:
  push:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
      - 'docs/**'
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - '**.md'
      - 'docs/**'

push-pr-dedup.name: Push/PR Run Dedup
push-pr-dedup.description: Run CI once per head when a workflow triggers on both push and pull_request: the pull_request run cancels the push run of the same commit

dependency-caching.name: Dependency Caching
dependency-caching.description: Cache dependencies to speed up builds

template.yaml:
- uses: actions/cache@v4
  with:
    path: ~/.npm
    key: ${{ runner.os }}-node-${{ hashFiles('**/package-lock.json') }}
    restore-keys: |
      ${{ runner.os }}-node-

dependency-audit.name: Dependency Audit
dependency-audit.description: Scan for high-severity vulnerabilities in dependencies; the npm step defers advisories whose only fixes are still inside the .npmrc min-release-age cooldown

template.yaml:
- name: Audit dependencies (high severity, cooldown-aware)
  run: node .github/scripts/audit-cooldown-check.js

dependabot.name: Dependabot with Cooldowns
dependabot.description: Weekly Dependabot updates with patch/minor grouping, 7/14/30-day semver cooldowns and a review:breaking label on majors

template.yaml:
version: 2
updates:
  # npm dependencies, runtime and dev.
  # - Patch and minor updates are grouped into one PR per week (less churn).
  # - Major updates stay ungrouped and get the `review:breaking` label so a
  #   maintainer evaluates API compatibility before merge. The label is applied
  #   post-open by `.github/workflows/dependabot-label-majors.yml`.
  # - No auto-merge anywhere; every PR passes through the existing CI gates.
  - package-ecosystem: npm
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
    open-pull-requests-limit: 10
    labels:
      - dependencies
    commit-message:
      prefix: "deps"
    # Dependency cooldown, tiered by semver risk: a major is where a compromised
    # maintainer has the most room to hide a change behind expected breaking
    # churn. GitHub's default for version updates is 3 days; the permitted
    # range is 1-90.
    #
    # KNOWN GAP, accepted deliberately: cooldown does NOT apply to Dependabot
    # SECURITY updates. Both this and .npmrc treat "there is a CVE" as grounds
    # to skip the wait, which is backwards for supply-chain compromise
    # specifically -- a fabricated or hyped advisory is a plausible way to
    # pressure fast adoption. The .npmrc min-release-age partially backstops
    # it by constraining resolution regardless of why an upgrade is happening.
    cooldown:
      default-days: 7
      semver-patch-days: 7
      semver-minor-days: 14
      semver-major-days: 30
    groups:
      patch-minor:
        applies-to: version-updates
        patterns:
          - "*"
        update-types:
          - "patch"
          - "minor"

  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: /
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
    open-pull-requests-limit: 5
    labels:
      - dependencies
      - ci
    commit-message:
      prefix: "ci"

deploy-on-tag.name: Deploy on Tag
deploy-on-tag.description: Trigger deployment when version tags are pushed

template.yaml:
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

codeql-analysis.name: CodeQL Analysis
codeql-analysis.description: GitHub security scanning for code vulnerabilities

template.yaml:
- uses: github/codeql-action/init@v3
  with:
    languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
- uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v3

coverage-upload.name: Coverage Upload
coverage-upload.description: Upload test coverage to Codecov or Coveralls

template.yaml:
- uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
    fail_ci_if_error: false

- name: Lint commit messages
  uses: wagoid/commitlint-github-action@v5

stale-cleanup.name: Stale Issue Cleanup
stale-cleanup.description: Automatically close inactive issues and PRs

template.yaml:
- uses: actions/stale@v9
  with:
    stale-issue-message: 'This issue has been automatically marked as stale.'
    days-before-stale: 60
    days-before-close: 7

artifact-retention.name: Artifact Retention
artifact-retention.description: Set short retention on upload-artifact to avoid exhausting free-tier 500 MB quota

template.yaml: retention-days: 1

artifact-conditional-upload.name: Artifact Conditional Upload
artifact-conditional-upload.description: Only upload artifacts on tag pushes — PR builds don't need them

template.yaml: if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')

artifact-cleanup.name: Artifact Cleanup
artifact-cleanup.description: Delete temporary artifacts after release publish to free quota

template.yaml:
- name: Clean up build artifacts
  uses: geekyeggo/delete-artifact@v5
  with:
    name: build-output

vercel-deploy.name: Vercel Deploy
vercel-deploy.description: Deploy preview and production environments to Vercel

railway-deploy.name: Railway Deploy
railway-deploy.description: Deploy preview and production environments to Railway

render-deploy.name: Render Deploy
render-deploy.description: Deploy preview and production environments to Render

template.yaml:
- name: Deploy to Render
  run: |
    curl -X POST "https://api.render.com/v1/services/${{ vars.RENDER_SERVICE_ID }}/deploys"
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.RENDER_API_KEY }}"

digitalocean-deploy.name: DigitalOcean Deploy
digitalocean-deploy.description: Deploy preview and production environments to DigitalOcean App Platform

template.yaml:
- name: Deploy to DigitalOcean
  uses: digitalocean/action-doctl@v2
  with:
    token: ${{ secrets.DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
